episodes.synopsis: At the bar, Éclair Éklair Éklare notices Sous-chef looking troubled. In a flashback, Sous-chef was ordered by Ainz Ooal Gown and Albedo to allow the Pleiades to work part-time at his bar to gain social interaction experience. Ainz plans for Nazarick to welcome various races, so they need to learn to interact with them. In the present, Sous-chef expresses concern to Éclair that the additional help may change the bar's atmosphere. As he prepares a drink for Éclair, the birdman assures him that he'll handle the cleaning, but Sous-chef declines, stating the place is already clean.
episodes.title: Episodio 43

episodes.synopsis: At the 9th Floor bar, Yuri Alpha and Narberal Gamma thank Sous-chef for instructing them and address him as "Master," making him flustered. They insist it's the correct title since he's now their instructor. Sous-chef accepts, and they begin their training. He explains the importance of a relaxing atmosphere and clear glasses at a bar. Their first task is to wipe a glass clean, but Yuri attempts to punch it to test durability, stopped by Sous-chef. Narberal uses magic to make herself and the glass invisible, thinking she achieved the goal. The maids find the task unexpectedly challenging, and Éclair Éklair Éklare chuckles at the scene. The episode concludes with one of the maids accidentally breaking a glass, adding a humorous twist to their training.
episodes.title: Episodio 44

episodes.synopsis: At the bar, Lupusregina Beta and CZ2128 Delta begin their training under Sous-chef's guidance. Lupusregina enthusiastically addresses him as "Master," but he feels a bit uneasy. Instead of cleaning glasses, Sous-chef decides to give them an introductory lesson on creating a welcoming bar atmosphere. Lupusregina attempts a maid café greeting, but Sous-chef explains it's not suitable for a bar. He emphasizes that bartenders must create an environment where customers want to return. However, Sous-chef gets distracted when he finds CZ hugging Éclair Éklair Éklare tightly. He reminds her that Éclair is a customer, and bartenders should maintain distance. CZ uses her Magic Gun's scope to observe Éclair from afar, creating tension for the birdman. Meanwhile, Lupusregina impresses Sous-chef by balancing three shot glasses on a concentrated CZ, adding a comedic touch to their training.
episodes.title: Episodio 45

episodes.synopsis: Solution Epsilon and Entoma Vasilissa Zeta arrive at the bar for training, but Sous-chef insists on a strict "no bugs" policy, confusing them. He emphasizes maintaining the bar's quality and cleanliness. They are tasked with dusting and bug-proofing the bar, which disappoints Solution. She refuses to clean due to her pride as a slime. Éclair Éklair Éklare volunteers to help clean, and Solution slyly convinces her to take on the task. However, Entoma returns with a cockroach snack, annoying Sous-chef, who already has his hands full with the quirky maids. Despite his faceless expressions, Sous-chef faces comedic challenges as he tries to maintain order and cleanliness in the bar.
episodes.title: Episodio 46

episodes.synopsis: Pestonya Shortcake Wanko and Éclair Éklair Éklare enjoy hot beverages at the bar with Sous-chef. He shares the challenges of teaching the combat-focused Pleiades to act like maids. Pestonya understands, as their purpose is to please the Supreme Beings. Éclair suggests making Sous-chef the ruler of Nazarick to avoid unreasonable tasks and keep the bar free of combat maids. However, this idea receives a cold response from their colleagues, and they gently scold Éclair for such thoughts. Feeling embarrassed and depressed, Éclair is consoled by Pestonya, who believes his behavior is influenced by the Supreme Beings. Inspired by their friendship, Sous-chef offers them a new drink, which they find delicious. They notice Pestonya has stopped using her "~woof" speech ticks and bark in embarrassment. A heartwarming moment ensues as the three continue to bond at the bar.
episodes.title: Episodio 47

episodes.synopsis: At the bar, Narberal Gamma serves Mare Bello Fiore a drink, and they discuss their companions. Mare enjoys the drink, wishing Aura could join him. Narberal mentions that sometimes they quarrel, especially due to Lupusregina Beta's troublemaking behavior. Mare points out that Narberal and Solution Epsilon share similar personalities. Sous-chef observes Narberal's easy-going nature, likely influenced by her time outside with Ainz Ooal Gown. Meanwhile, Éclair Éklair Éklare asks for a wet towel and receives it thrown in his face by Narberal, surprising Sous-chef. Éclair claims he'll be the future ruler of Nazarick, but Mare advises him to abandon the dream for his safety. Narberal throws towels at Éclair when he talks about his ambitions, though Sous-chef finds it unacceptable behavior towards customers. Narberal offers Mare to participate, but he declines, stating that Éclair would be obliterated if he did. Despite the risks, Éclair remains undeterred in pursuing his dream.
episodes.title: Episodio 48

episodes.synopsis: Shalltear Bloodfallen enters the bar and is greeted by Lupusregina Beta, who announces it's now an open juice bar, confusing Shalltear. Sous-chef clarifies that the theme remains the same. Sous-chef warns Shalltear not to drink too much like before, but she assures him she's fine. Lupusregina teases Shalltear about being "full of stuffing," to which she playfully agrees. To distract Shalltear, Sous-chef offers her a celebratory cocktail, which she gladly accepts. Lupusregina prepares the drink, and Shalltear finds it delicious. Sous-chef suggests naming it after her, but Lupusregina playfully suggests "Flatchest Vampire Airline," before being stopped. Shalltear is left confused by the banter, enjoying her time at the bar.
episodes.title: Episodio 49

episodes.synopsis: At the bar, Entoma Vasilissa Zeta offers Cocytus a bowl of sweets. Cocytus mentions Ainz Ooal Gown's plan of using "carrots and sticks," surprising Sous-chef and Entoma. Cocytus praises Ainz's greatness, and Sous-chef admits his confusion about the Pleiades' purpose at the bar. Entoma reminds them to think for themselves, impressing them with her eloquence. They discuss her hunger affecting her thoughts, but she assures them she ate before coming. Entoma playfully removes her mask to show her "pale" complexion, indicating hunger. Cocytus offers candy to ease her hunger, while Sous-chef apologizes for not having prepared food. Cocytus also craves more substantial fare. Éclair Éklair Éklare jokingly muses about Entoma's true nature. Despite eating candy, Entoma still hungers and eyes Éclair, who squeaks in fright at the sight of her drooling.
episodes.title: Episodio 50

episodes.synopsis: At the Bar, Sous-chef attends to Éclair Éklair Éklare and Albedo, while CZ2128 Delta playfully balances ice cubes on Éclair's head. Albedo sighs, expressing concern about Ainz Ooal Gown's upcoming battles. She worries about the inadequacy of their forces to conquer their targets efficiently. Sous-chef recalls Pestonya's talk about a special favor, but CZ interrupts, signaling to Éclair not to reveal the secret. Instead, Éclair jokes about becoming the next ruler if Ainz fails. Sous-chef reassures Albedo, stating they can't comprehend Ainz's true motives for the conflict. The true reason remains a secret, and Éclair thanks CZ, offering her to continue playing with the ice cubes on his head.
episodes.title: Episodio 51

episodes.synopsis: Aura Bella Fiora enjoys cola and spaghetti prepared by Yuri Alpha at the bar. Sous-chef learns about Aura's upcoming errand to capture nobles, sending them to Neuronist Painkill, a fate worse than death. Yuri invites Aura to hang out later with Pestonya Shortcake Wanko for a meal. Aura is delighted, but Éclair Éklair Éklare's cough interrupts. Sous-chef passes his drink to Éclair, and the conversation continues. Aura praises Yuri's cooking, though the maid humbly mentions Pestonya's dishes are better. Aura finds both their cooking styles unique. Another cough from Éclair makes Sous-chef suggest he join the conversation, but the penguin denies any jealousy. As Sous-chef heads to the back room, Aura overhears his frustrations, using her keen hearing.
episodes.title: Episodio 52

episodes.synopsis: At the bar, Sous-chef cleans alongside Solution Epsilon, discussing the upcoming advance of the Sorcerer Kingdom into the Re-Estize Kingdom. He recalls Demiurge's plans and hopes the bar will return to normal after the conquest. Solution playfully teases him, asking if he dislikes the company of beautiful women. Sous-chef compliments her observational skills, making her the most suited Pleiades for bartending. In a flashback, Demiurge praises Solution and expresses his desire for a Solution of his own. Back in the present, Sous-chef plans to improve the bar experience for Demiurge. Solution asks if he likes the quiet atmosphere and points to blushing Éclair Éklair Éklare, wondering if he'll be a problem. Sous-chef assures he won't be, as Éclair is quiet and afraid of Demiurge and Solution.
episodes.title: Episodio 53

episodes.synopsis: At the bar, Sous-chef welcomes Sebas Tian and Tsuare, who were recommended to visit. The maids, Pleiades, are off for the day, but the unchanged atmosphere remains. Éclair encourages Tsuare to choose a drink while Sebas thanks Éclair for guiding her. Sous-chef presents a special cocktail called Tuarabas on the house. The Pleiades watch from behind the door, claiming they're working overtime, not spying. Sebas hears Tsuare's call, but it's just her embarrassment after sipping from a straw. Both blush, and Éclair cheers them on as Sous-chef playfully calls the onlookers "children."
episodes.title: Episodio 54

episodes.synopsis: Ainz Ooal Gown sits at the Bar, discussing the Pleiades' training with Sous-chef. Misinterpreting Ainz's question, Sous-chef admits the maids clashed with the bar's solemn atmosphere but praises their friendliness and potential for smooth communication with other races. Ainz understands and appreciates the atmosphere created by Sous-chef's creator. Touched by Ainz's praise, Sous-chef vows to make the bar the premiere destination in Nazarick. Éclair appears, offering to clean the mess, and Ainz thanks him for his contribution during the maid's training. Éclair humorously thinks he's being considered as Ainz's replacement, but it's quickly denied. As the episode ends, Éclair remarks on Ainz's drink, unaware that he cannot consume it.
episodes.title: Episodio 55

episodes.synopsis: Rito, Mari, and Kotoko run a pop-up shop called "PARK" in Harajuku. Aliens come to Earth and begin stealing its culture. A girl calling herself Misa appears and helps the girls defend Harajuku from the invaders.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Rito, Mari, and Kotoko form a bubble over Harajuku, locking them inside. A powerful Scooper breaks into the bubble and begins to attack. They band together to defeat it.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Rito and friends learn there are other survivors inside the bubble besides themselves. One of the survivors, Sayumi, is handing out hand made crepes to the people of Harajuku. Inspired by Sayumi, the trio begins preparing to re-open PARK.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Kotoko's acting strange. She always acts strange, but not pulling-out-people's-hair and lurking-about-with-syringes strange. Rito and Mari are suspicious of her behavior, but Kotoko refuses to explain herself because she's afraid of being alone again.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Harajuku's been turned into a safari park?! Giraffe, alligator, and zebra shaped Scoopers are all over town. Misa tries to chase away a bird that has flown into PARK. Rito and friends hurry after the bird and find that color has been stolen from all over!
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Rito is overjoyed when everyone tells her they like her drawing of the house she once lived in with her parents. But then one of her drawings is taken by a powerful Scooper! Misa suggests they cheer up by creating beaded accessories.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: When the girls are told they're no longer human, they're unable to accept reality, and Rito, Mari, and Kotoko clash fiercely. Rito is overwhelmed by the shock, and Sayumi kindly cheers her up.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Rito is shocked when she finds Mari and Kotoko stuffing their faces full of sweets. Their friend and ally Sayumi appears bringing a new crepe she wants the three of them to eat. Claiming it can grant any wish, she urges them to eat it.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Rito's body transforms rapidly into a Scooper. Mari and Rito are relieved to see her obsessively eat candy, but she suddenly groans in pain. Rito begins running out of control. In a desperate attempt to stop her, Mari and Kotoko turn their weapons against her. Seeing the tears in her eyes, they think back on the days leading up to the opening of PARK.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: The furious Ebifurya attempts to capture the girls himself. However, Misa attempts to stop him. When Misa describes her admiration and feelings towards creativity, the girls are deeply sympathetic. And then she reveals a shocking truth.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Rito and her friends are deeply shocked to hear the truth. Meanwhile, the agitated Ebifurya becomes even more openly hostile...
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: The Amatsumara responds to Misa's powerful resolve and creativity, creating colorful beads that fall from the sky like rain. Rito, Mari, and Kotoko join Misa in their final showdown against Ebifurya!

info.title: Mokke

info.synopsis: Rudger è l'amico immaginario di Amanda Shuffleup; nessun altro può vederlo e la loro amicizia sembra andare a gonfie vele. Un giorno però, al cospetto di Amanda, si presenta il malvagio Mr. Bunting: l'uomo è famoso per dare la caccia ai cosiddetti "immaginari" e qualcuno dice che addirittura si nutra di essi. Presto Rudger si troverà da solo a scappare nella sua vita immaginaria. Ha bisogno di trovare Amanda prima che Bunting lo prenda e prima che la stessa Amanda lo dimentichi e lui svanisca nel nulla. Ma come può un ragazzo irreale stare da solo nel mondo reale?
info.title: The Imaginary (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: As the Gundam Fight is about to begin, Domon Kasshu, the Gundam Fighter of Neo Japan, arrives on Earth after his Shining Gundam has unexpectedly veered off course and crashes in Rome.
episodes.title: Gundam Fight Begins! The Gundam That Fell to Earth

episodes.synopsis: As New York City is abuzz about Chibodee Crocket, the Gundam Fighter of Neo America, and his Gundam Maxter, Domon appears during a boxing match to challenge Chibodee to a Gundam Fight.
episodes.title: Roar of the Winning Punch

episodes.synopsis: As Domon travels to Neo China, he is approached by two Shaolin monks who urge him to take on the Gundam Fighter of Neo China, who has apparently gone rogue.
episodes.title: Beat the Dragon Gundam

episodes.synopsis: In his eagerness, Domon interrupts a fight between Neo France's representative, George de Sand, and another opponent, but George, disgusted at this cavalier attitude, refuses to accept the challenge.
episodes.title: Challenge! The Red Rose Knight

episodes.synopsis: In Neo Russia, Domon has gone after the country's Gundam Fighter, but he is arrested by the local police and thrown into a large prison.
episodes.title: Great Escape! A Captive Gundam Fighter

episodes.synopsis: Domon returns to the Neo Japan space colony. There he undergoes a virtual reality simulation to determine if he is the right choice for Neo Japan's Gundam Fighter.
episodes.title: Fight, Domon! Earth is the Ring

episodes.synopsis: Domon goes to Neo Mexico in order to fight the Gundam Fighter, Chico Rodriguez, but upon arrival he learns that the fighter has run away and is being hunted by the local authorities.
episodes.title: Prepare to Fight! Desperate Fugitive

episodes.synopsis: Domon travels to Neo Canada to fight Andrew Graham and his Lumber Gundam, but Andrew refuses, and he is defeated unofficially, as no official match takes place.
episodes.title: Old Grudge: Revenge of the Space Police

episodes.synopsis: Domon tries to defeat Neo England's Gentle Chapman who has won his fights through the use of unfair tactics.
episodes.title: Powerful Enemy! Chapman's Heroic Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Domon and Rain travel to Neo Egypt in order to face off against the Pharaoh Gundam XIII there. Upon arriving, they find out the Gundam and its crew have been destroyed by a "ghost".
episodes.title: Terror! The Phantom Fighter Appears

episodes.synopsis: In Neo Turkey Rain runs into an old friend, Saette Gyuzelle, from school. It is revealed that he is the Neo Turkey Gundam Fighter and he has been taken over by DG cells.
episodes.title: Reunion in Falling Rain

episodes.synopsis: Reports of the Devil Gundam surfacing in Shinjuku send Domon and Rain to Neo Japan. They run into an army of Death Army mobile suits controlled by the Devil Gundam and Domon tries to call his Shining Gundam.
episodes.title: He's the Undefeated of the East! Master Asia Appears

episodes.synopsis: Domon and Master Asia set out to search for survivors. Master leaves Domon alone and Domon is attacked by Chibodee Crocket, Argo Gulskii, Sai Saichi, and George de Sand.
episodes.title: Big Trouble! Domon vs. Big 5

episodes.synopsis: Rain notices that there are four unidentified objects heading for Earth. She also notices that Master is going into an abandoned subway station. She follows him and loses him.
episodes.title: Shocking! Shining Finger Defeated

episodes.synopsis: A Death Army soldier comes to tell Domon that he is to meet with Master Asia alone at the Tokyo Tower. Domon goes, but along the way is stopped by his four friends.
episodes.title: Warrior's Crest! Goodbye, Shuffle Alliance

episodes.synopsis: An earthquake shakes Shinjuku, and all the members of the Shuffle Alliance along with their crews are trapped underground. Rain stumbles upon the Devil Gundam, which is absorbing its Death Army mobile suits.
episodes.title: Ultimate Power and Evil! Rise of the Dark Gundam

episodes.synopsis: Master Asia uses his knowledge of Domon and his reactions in order to lure Domon away from Shinjuku. While chasing what appears to be the Master Gundam, he is stopped by Schwarz Bruder, who tries to persuade him to stop chasing after Master Asia.
episodes.title: Challenge! Mysterious Masked Fighter

episodes.synopsis: Chibodee's pit crew notice how strange Chibodee has been acting lately, so they run off to the Guyana Highlands. Chibodee chases them, and in the process he finds Domon and begins to train with him.
episodes.title: Steal the Secret! Scheme of the Beautiful Warriors

episodes.synopsis: Domon and Rain are still training the Guyana Highlands. Rain is fixing the Shining Gundam while Domon continues his training.
episodes.title: Fierce Battle! Dragon Gundam vs. Bolt Gundam

episodes.synopsis: Practicing with his butler, George is haunted by a massacre that occurred in the Neo France colony a year before. He was fighting a fellow candidate for the 13th Gundam Fight, Jean-Pierre Mirabeau, when the king refused to acknowledge Mirabeau as the winner due to his unfair tactics.
episodes.title: George, Beat the Nightmare!

episodes.synopsis: With the finals only 3 days away, the four other members of the Shuffle Alliance wait for Domon to finish his training so they can leave for Neo Hong Kong, where the finals will take place.
episodes.title: The Final Battle Approaches! Only 3 Days Away

episodes.synopsis: Being attacked by several Gundam Heads the Shuffle Alliance and crew retreat. The Shuffle Alliance members decide to fight the Death Army in order to give Rain and Domon time to fix the Shining Gundam which was heavily damaged by Master Asia.
episodes.title: Breakthrough! Warriors Strong Ties

episodes.synopsis: The other members of the Shuffle Alliance all escape the Guyana Highlands. Domon stays back to defeat Master Asia and the Devil Gundam.
episodes.title: Destined Battle! Domon vs. Dark Gundam

episodes.synopsis: The four members of the Shuffle Alliance reach Neo Hong Kong for the finals, however Domon is not there. Still trapped in the Guyana Highlands, he spots a Neo Japan capsule containing the God Gundam.
episodes.title: Bright New Star! The Birth of the Burning Gundam

episodes.synopsis: Domon arrives in Neo Hong Kong moments before the deadline. The opening ceremonies start and Domon and the others are surprised to learn that Master Asia is back in his Master Gundam.
episodes.title: All Fighters Gathered! The Final Battles Begin

episodes.synopsis: The finals have started and Domon's first opponent is Zeus Gundam, the favorite to win the championship. Domon is restless, so he goes through Neo Hong Kong looking for a place to stay.
episodes.title: A New Weapon! Erupting Burning Finger

episodes.synopsis: Domon is about to face off against Cobra Gundam of Neo India. The pilot of Cobra Gundam has no qualms about hurting Domon before the match.
episodes.title: Hang on Domon! Triumph of the Restored Faith

episodes.synopsis: Schwarz Bruder fights the Viking Gundam, easily defeating it. Domon's next opponent, Kyral Mekirel, is an assassin who has one all of his matches by default by killing his opponents before the matches.
episodes.title: Domon Targeted! The Assassin's Staff

episodes.synopsis: Sai Saici's next opponent is the Mermaid Gundam. However he is distracted as he falls in love with the pilot's sister, Cecil.
episodes.title: Running Away! Sai Saici In Love

episodes.synopsis: Domon is set to face off against Allenby Beardsely, a female Gundam Fighter who defeated Argo in under a minute. He meets her in an arcade and fights her in a fighting simulator, ending in a tie after the machine breaks down.
episodes.title: Beautiful Fighter! Dangerous Allenby

episodes.synopsis: Chibodee lost his mother to a group of terrorist clowns and since then has been afraid of them. When his next opponent is Jester Gundam who copies everyone's moves it looks like Chibodee will lose fairly quickly.
episodes.title: Dazzling Power of the Clown! Get Mad, Gundam Maxter

episodes.synopsis: Michelo Chariot is Domon's next opponent. Michelo and other fighters Domon has faced off with in the past set some traps to hurt Domon and the other Shuffle Alliance members.
episodes.title: Dangerous Trap! Neros Gundam Strikes Back

episodes.synopsis: George's next opponent is Gentle Chapman. Like Michelo Chariot, Chapman is under the influence of Master Asia and the Devil Gundam.
episodes.title: Emissary of Darkness! Chapman Rises Again

episodes.synopsis: Schwarz Bruder goes to the Neo Hong Kong government building and sees the Devil Gundam in there healing. He is noticed by Master Asia, and he flees. He spots Rain following him and carries her to safety.
episodes.title: Stand Up Domon! Raging Tag Match

episodes.synopsis: Now that the Devil Gundam is back, Domon requests the help of the Shuffle Alliance. However, they all refuse because the only person they want to fight is Domon.
episodes.title: Showdown! Bursting Machine Gun Punch

episodes.synopsis: George and Domon are set to fight each other, but the King of Neo France says there is no need, so he locks up Gundam Rose. However, George's feelings are so strong he steals Gundam Rose and challenges Domon to a fight.
episodes.title: A Knights' Pride! Gundam Rose Stolen

episodes.synopsis: The day before he is to fight Domon, Sai Saici isn't at all worried about the match. However after reading his father's will he decides to win the Battle Royale to revive the Shaolin Temple which was one of his father's wishes.
episodes.title: Sai Saici's New Attack! Blazing Dragon Gundam

episodes.synopsis: Andrew Graham of Neo Canada is facing off against Argo. Argo goes into Hyper Mode and uses a new technique, the Gaia Crusher, to create mountains in the ring.
episodes.title: Domon vs. Argo! Charging Bolt Gundam

episodes.synopsis: Domon goes looking for Allenby because she went missing. He yelled at Rain because she was supposed to look after Allenby. Fuun Saiki, Master Asia's horse, comes and delivers Domon to Master Asia.
episodes.title: The Ultimate Attack! Duel With Master Asia

episodes.synopsis: Domon is set to fight against Schwarz to determine the overall winner of the individual matches. Prime Minister Wong has the ring rigged with 5,000 time bombs set to explode after 8 minutes just in case there is no winner determined by that time.
episodes.title: A Ruthless Fight! Schwarz's Last Match

episodes.synopsis: Domon has Rain go scope out the situation with Schwarz/Kyoji while he goes to the Battle Royale. Rain sneaks in as a doctor and discovers that Schwarz is an android made up of DG cells. Rain's father also finds out since he's an expert in cybernetics.
episodes.title: Battle Royal Begins! Dark Gundam Revived

episodes.synopsis: With the help of Sai Saici and Argo, Domon defeats Michelo and heads for the next Heavenly King, Grand Gundam. Meanwhile at the hospital it is revealed the Devil Gundam was intended to restore the Earth.
episodes.title: Assault of the Four Evil Kings! Soaring Raven Gundam

episodes.synopsis: After Chibodee and George have defeated the Grand Gundam, Allenby appears and seems to be under the influence of the DG cells and Domon tries to reason with her.
episodes.title: Royal Counterattack! Ambush of the Grand Gundam

episodes.synopsis: Rain manages to save Allenby by destroying the Walter Gundam. Schwarz and Kyoji sacrifice themselves so Domon can destroy the Devil Gundam's cockpit, defeating it.
episodes.title: Schwarz Rests in Grace! Domon's Tearful Attack

episodes.synopsis: The final fight begins. Domon and Master Asia fight an extraordinary battle, and Domon convinces Master Asia's plans would've failed anyway.
episodes.title: Farewell Master: Master Asia's Last Breath

episodes.synopsis: Domon burns the Master Gundam and Master Asia's body, proclaiming it to be the last time he will shed tears for Master Asia. The Devil Gundam needs a Core Life Unit that can produce life to function at its full potential.
episodes.title: Rain's Crisis: Return of the Dark Gundam

episodes.synopsis: Ulube now has the Devil Gundam at its full power, but though diabolical, he does not risk innocent lives, ordering an evacuation of the Neo Japan space colony.
episodes.title: Dark Colony Activated: Attack of the Shuffle Alliance

episodes.synopsis: Domon's father is now out of his cryogenic state and says that to beat the Devil Gundam Domon must destroy the colony's power source. Gundams from around the world gather to defend the Earth from the Devil Gundam.
episodes.title: Earth's S.O.S.: Gundam Federation Rescue

episodes.synopsis: Thanks to the Devil Gundam's self-recovery the Grand Master Gundam is resurrected and the Shuffle Alliance struggle to defeat it. The Devil Gundam Colony begins extending towards Earth, taking over most of it.
episodes.title: Burning Gundam's Great Triumph: A Hopeful Future; Ready, Go!

info.synopsis: In un lontano futuro l'umanità ha quasi interamente abbandonato la Terra per trasferirsi nelle colonie spaziali. Ogni nazione terrestre possiede una colonia orbitante ai confini dell'atmosfera, e per evitare conflitti tra di esse ogni quattro anni viene organizzato il "Gundam Fight", un torneo in cui i rappresentanti delle varie nazioni si sfidano in combattimento a bordo di robot umanoidi chiamati Gundam. Il vincitore di questa sfida guadagna per il suo paese il diritto di governare tutte le colonie spaziali fino al torneo successivo. Domon Kasshu, maestro di arti marziali e pilota dello Shining Gundam, viene costretto a partecipare alla competizione come rappresentante di Neo Japan. Solo vincendo potrà infatti ottenere la libertà per suo padre, agli arresti per aver costruito il Devil Gundam, un pericolosissimo Gundam sperimentale. Ma la vittoria non è il suo unico obbiettivo: Domon vuole anche sfruttare il torneo per rintracciare e fermare suo fratello Kyoji, che dopo aver assassinato la loro madre è fuggito verso la Terra con il Devil Gundam, scatenandone tutto il potere distruttivo.
info.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam

episodes.synopsis: 生徒会室に集まった五人。しかし、始まったのは生徒会活動ではなく究極のたこ焼き研究会！？どうやら、たこに代わる至高の具材を決めることが目的のよう。稀代のたこ焼き大好き娘、華乃が取り仕切る中、さまざまな具のたこ焼きが作られていく。果たして究極のたこ焼きは決まるのか。そしてその具とは一体……。
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: 雪景シキの生放送本番中、妃愛、詩桜、天梨、華乃の四人はあすみの家にお邪魔していた。別室であすみの様子を興味深そうに観察している三人と、一人泣き叫ぶ華乃。華乃は雪景シキのイラストレーター「ののか」として、生放送のゲストに呼ばれていたのだった。出演のお願いを快諾してしまった過去の自分を恨む華乃。その間にも登場時刻は着々と近づいてきて……。
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: 同人誌即売会に参加する華乃と、その手伝いで来た天梨と詩桜。ところが、発注ミスで想定よりも多くの同人誌が届いてしまう。なんとか売り切ろうと頑張る三人だったが、途中で客足が途絶え、同人誌も多く残ってしまった。諦めムードの華乃だったが、スペースに近づく影があり……。
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: 覇権声優・和泉妃愛は、日々の努力を怠らない。美しき白鳥の如く、見えないところで懸命に足を動かしているのだ。そんな妃愛が次に出演するのは『戦え！撮り鉄娘』の二期。四人の協力を得ながら練習を進めていくが、最後のセリフだけがどうしても上手くいかない。それもそのはず、そのセリフはまさかのアドリブで……。
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: イラストレーターとして、何度もブルマ姿のキャラクターを描いてきた華乃。しかし、実際にブルマ姿を見たことがないことに気づき、プロとしてこのままで良いのかと悩み始める。そこで、彼女は妃愛、あすみ、詩桜、天梨に頼んで実際に着てもらうことに。目を輝かせながらスケッチをする華乃だったが……。
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: 一年前の秋。夕方、生徒会室にて一人で黙々と作業する詩桜。かつては五人いた生徒会役員も、詩桜一人になってしまった。部屋に響くのはキーボードを叩く音のみ。嫌でも、脳裏に辞めていった役員たちの声が響く。これは現生徒会発足より前にあった、カリスマ生徒会長鎌倉詩桜の知られざる物語。
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: よく晴れた絶好の海日和。五人は砂浜で水遊び……ではなく、何故か船の上に！？一人で淡々と釣りをする詩桜。それに影響され、他の四人もそれぞれ思いのままに船上でのひとときを過ごす。景色を楽しもうとする妃愛と華乃だったが、詩桜に乗せられて釣りをすることになり……。
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: 休日に集まってお城巡りをする五人。関東近郊のお城を、発案者である天梨が詳しく解説を入れながら巡っていく。詩桜でも知らなかったような知識をこともなげに解説する天梨に感心する華乃だったが、お城を巡るにつれ、何やら不自然な点が見えてきて……。
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: 早朝、千玉市内の某所。免許と車を手に入れた詩桜は、四人を誘って人生初のドライブに行くことに。詩桜が購入したのはなんとジープ！　千玉市の道路にそぐわぬ見た目をした新車を前に感動する四人。道中も新車の話題で盛り上がる中、車は高速道路に突入していく。
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: 四人と露天風呂にやって来たあすみ。みんなが脱衣所で着替える中、ひと足先に湯船に浸かったあすみは、黒く不気味な形をした物体が浮いているのを目にする。「これってもしかしてアレなの？ でも、なんでこんなところに？」と戸惑うあすみだったが、考えている間に四人が露天風呂に入ってきてしまい……。
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: 「私は小さなころから大抵のことは人並みにできる子で、少し社会を知った気になって、大人びたつもりでいた」文化祭での妃愛の朗読劇。その内容は『私』の秘められた真実と、『私』から『兄』への感謝の物語――。原作屈指の人気エピソード、『兄妹ぼっち』をアニメ版にアレンジ！
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: 文化祭が無事終わり、焼肉屋で打ち上げをする生徒会メンバー＋α。先生のおごりということもあり、注文した肉を食べ至福の時間を過ごしていたが、なぜか突然シャトーブリアン五人前が届いてしまう。状況がつかめず焦る五人であったが……。
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: È la fine di giugno e Tomohiro Izumi, studente piuttosto timido e introverso, sta trascorrendo un altro giorno tranquillo nel suo solito angolo della classe... o almeno così pensava! All'improvviso gli giunge la notizia che è stato sorteggiato nella lotteria dell'accademia per diventare il prossimo presidente del consiglio studentesco. Ora i riflettori sono improvvisamente puntati tutti su di lui e le sue giornate spensierate sembrano finite. Dopo vari colpi di scena e candidature particolari, verrà fuori una lotta senza esclusione di colpi per la scelta dei membri del consiglio!
info.title: Hamidashi Creative

episodes.synopsis: The appraiser Ein is exploring a dungeon with his party, who keep mistreating him and call him "trash picker." As they venture further, they get swarmed by a pack of strong monsters called Hell Hounds. In order to survive, Ein's party members Zoid and Jolene betray him and leave him behind as bait, dooming him to a certain and painful death!
episodes.title: Episodio 1

info.synopsis:
Ultima estate del 20° secolo: l'umanità scopre di non essere la sola razza dominante sulla Terra. Giganteschi mostri emergono dagli angoli più remoti e nascosti del pianeta e, fra questi kaiju, l'immenso Godzilla sembra il solo capace di affrontarli e distruggerli. Dopo una feroce guerra durata mezzo secolo e segnata da innumerevoli sconfitte e massacri, i governi della Terra decidono di abbandonare il pianeta cercando la salvezza in una pericolosa migrazione verso un altro mondo, individuato a 11,9 anni luce di distanza. Le risorse rimaste sono concentrate nella costruzione di una nave interstellare, l'Aratrum, capace di compiere il viaggio in pochi decenni. Non tutti partiranno: l'equipaggio della nave viene scelto da un'intelligenza artificiale! A loro il compito di varcare l'abisso spaziale e fondare una nuova Terra.
Il viaggio dell'Aratrum, durato venti anni, si rivela un colossale fiasco. Il pianeta individuato non è adatto a sostenere la vita umana. Dell'equipaggio fa parte anche Haruno, che a soli quattro anni ha visto i suoi genitori uccisi da Godzilla. Per tutto il lungo viaggio ha continuato a covare il suo desiderio di vendetta contro il mostro. Quando una parte dell'equipaggio dell'Aratrum decide di tornare verso la Terra, il giovane si unisce a loro. Nessuno sa che il viaggio di ritorno è, se possibile, ancora più infausto.
Cercando pericolose scorciatoie nell'iperspazio per ridurre quanto più possibile i tempi del ritorno, l'equipaggio dell'Aratrum finisce per commettere un errore fatale: con sgomento, quando la Terra riappare davanti a loro, scoprono di aver compiuto involontariamente un vero viaggio nel tempo! Si ritrovano sbalzati di 20.000 anni nel futuro, con un pianeta molto cambiato, diventato veramente il pianeta dei mostri, e su di esso Godzilla regna incontrastato. Riusciranno gli umani a riconquistare il proprio pianeta? Quale destino attende Haruno?
info.title: Godzilla: Planet of the Monsters

info.synopsis: Satsuki Amamiya e la sua migliore amica An Kiriyama facevano parte del club di fotografia della scuola, con la prima che ammirava la senpai e presidentessa Sakihara. Questo fino a quando lei ed i restanti membri del terzo anno si sono diplomati, lasciando Satsuki nello sconforto ed il club nel caos. Per pura coincidenza una fotocamera comprata da Satsuki non arriva in tempo e, assieme ad An, vanno in visita al venditore per chiedere spiegazioni. Qui faranno la conoscenza con Haruno Akiyama, un'aspirante mangaka che vuole creare un manga entusiasmante con protagoniste delle studentesse delle superiori. A scuola le due incontrano Sakurako Shikishima, la presidentessa del club di cinema che sta vivendo un problema simile a quello di fotografia. Per evitarne la chiusura Sakurako ha l'idea di fonderli assieme dando vita al cinefoto club. Ora questo trio, assieme ad Haruno e alla motoblogger Kako Komada, si è prefissato un nuovo obiettivo: scattare foto nei luoghi turistici del Giappone per aiutare la mangaka a raggiungere il proprio sogno!

tvdb.synopsis: È l'anno 0123 UC, sono ormai passati trent'anni dall'ultima rivolta delle colonie guidata da Char Aznable, ma il seme dell'indipendenza è ancora vivo tra gli abitanti dello spazio. Una nuova organizzazione militare, la Crossbone Vanguard, esce allo scoperto per rivendicare l'autonomia delle colonie orbitali. La Federazione Terrestre è colta di sorpresa dall'attacco lanciato per occupare le colonie di Side 4, ribattezzato Frontier, e così Frontier IV cade in breve tempo in mano alla milizia. Tra gli sbigottiti abitanti della colonia c'è il giovane studente di ingegneria Seabook Arno, che, oltre ad assistere impotente alla morte di molti suoi amici, nella circostanza scopre anche la vera identità della ragazza di cui è innamorato, Cecily Fairchild, la quale in realtà è Berah Ronah, erede della potente famiglia a capo della Crossbone Vanguard. Nel susseguirsi degli eventi Seabook ritrova anche la madre, scienziata di fama creduta morta, che invece si era isolata per lavorare ad un nuovo mobile suit, il cui nome in codice è Gundam Formula 91. Imbarcatosi su una corazzata federale, Seabook accetta a malincuore di pilotare il Gundam, per scoprire così di essere un potente newtype capace di determinare le sorti del conflitto insieme alla ragazza che ama.

info.synopsis: Una notte, Arisu, si imbatte in una misteriosa trasmissione radiofonica che ha il potere di rasserenarlo: "Midnight Heart Tune". La voce suadente della conduttrice, conosciuta solo con il nome di Apollo, lo affascina e lo avvolge in un'atmosfera misteriosa, che presto diventa una parte imprescindibile delle sue notti. Tuttavia, con il passare del tempo, la trasmissione e la sua enigmatica dj scompaiono nel nulla, lasciando ad Arisu il solo ricordo di quella voce misteriosa. Non sa che aspetto abbia né il suo vero nome, tuttavia anni dopo, nel corso del liceo, Arisu scopre un nuovo indizio che potrebbe rivelare la vera identità di Apollo ed è proprio all'interno del club di radiodiffusione della sua scuola. Qui incontra quattro ragazze, ognuna delle quali con un sogno che ruota attorno all'uso della propria voce. Chi di loro sarà Apollo? Determinato a scoprire la verità, il ragazzo si imbarca in una missione che lo porterà a fare da guida e supporto a queste ragazze, aiutandole a realizzare i loro sogni e, forse, a svelare il segreto nascosto dietro "Midnight Heart Tune".
info.title: Tune In to the Midnight Heart

info.synopsis: Tredici anni fa, il mondo è crollato nel caos durante il "Giorno Rosso": un'epidemia fulminante ha spazzato via il 90% dell’umanità, trasformando i morti in orde di zombie famelici. Le grandi città sono diventate territori proibiti, dominio dei non-morti, mentre i pochi sopravvissuti si sono rifugiati in villaggi isolati, sognando un giorno di poterle riconquistare. Oggi, una nuova generazione di ragazzi è cresciuta conoscendo soltanto questo mondo spezzato, senza memoria diretta di com'era la vita prima della catastrofe. Tra loro c'è Aki, una ragazza vivace e determinata, che vive insieme ai suoi migliori amici, Haru e Natsuki. Quando Aki scopre che suo padre, scomparso da anni, potrebbe essere ancora vivo, decide di intraprendere un viaggio per ritrovarlo.
